statement: CIOPORA reports that in November 2020 Dutch Customs issued a Red Alert Notice at Rotterdam and confiscated two containers of approximately 10 tonnes and 16 tonnes of protected OZblu-variety blueberries shipped without licence by Rosle Berries / Ross Berries of the Rossouw Farming Group, South Africa, following termination in May 2020 of two licence agreements dating from 2017.
